title: Compute Module Custom Embedded Device Board
description: Custom Raspberry Pi Compute Module 5 carrier integrating battery management and power-path charging.
long_description: Designed a custom Raspberry Pi CM5 carrier board with integrated battery management, power-path charging, and hot-swap protection. Responsibilities included schematic capture, multi-layer PCB layout, battery charger selection, and firmware for power state management and safe shutdown.

specs.Networking: Pi5 Onboard, boosted by eSIM and RFID capabilities

outcome: Reliable battery-backed CM5 deployments in mobile test rigs.

title: The Long Century
description: A Victorian-era map and grand strategy game using C++, OpenGL, and multiplayer networking.
long_description: Developed core engine systems for 'The Long Century', a grand strategy game set in a richly-detailed Victorian world. Work included C++ gameplay systems, OpenGL rendering pipelines, deterministic multiplayer systems, and tools for map editing and scenario scripting.
outcome: Prototypes with deterministic multiplayer gameplay and a moddable map system.

title: Automated Drink Maker
description: An Arduino-driven assembly-line beverage maker for repeatable, high-strength drink production.
long_description: Built an automated drink maker using Arduino controllers and stepper-driven dispensers to deliver precise volumes and mixing on an assembly line. Implemented sensor feedback, safety interlocks, and a web interface for recipe control.
outcome: Produced repeatable high-ABV samples for QA and demonstration.

title: Vulkan Compute Accelerator
description: A Vulkan-based compute orchestrator that runs flows of prewritten compute shaders via a flowgraph.
long_description: Implemented a Vulkan compute accelerator to orchestrate compute shader tasks using a flowgraph abstraction. The project handled synchronization, memory management, and batching across multiple queues for high-throughput compute workloads.
outcome: Achieved efficient multi-shader orchestration and demonstrable throughput gains.

title: SPOT Robot Dog Action Wrapper
description: Wraps predefined actions of the Boston Robitics 'SPOT' dog from a device over a network to route to SPOT which uses a separate network.
long_description: Wraps predefined actions of the Boston Robitics 'SPOT' dog from a device over a network to route to SPOT which uses a separate network.

specs.Use: Remote Automation of SPOT for easier demonstration

outcome: Remote Control of the SPOT robot dog, solving several issues of controlling the Dog across the network.
